members.name: Rejoin
members.desc: `/tavern_rejoin`: the launcher is rejoining after installing a server's mods, so a refusal doesn't hand over to it again.

types.name: AuthLimits
types.summary: Internal: per-address limits on the auth port and console logins. 8 failures, or 5 wrong passwords, each within 60 seconds of the last, hold an address off until 60 quiet seconds pass.

members.name: MaxOpen
members.desc: 64 open connections in all.

members.name: MaxOpenPerAddress
members.desc: 8 open connections from one address.

members.name: FailLimit
members.desc: 8 failures.

members.name: PasswordFailLimit
members.desc: 5 wrong passwords.

members.name: Window
members.desc: The 60 second window failures are counted in.

members.name: PruneAbove
members.desc: Number of tracked addresses above which stale entries are dropped.

members.name: _sync
members.desc: Lock around the counters.

members.name: _open
members.desc: Open connection count by address.

members.name: _capLogged
members.desc: Addresses whose connection cap has been logged.

members.name: _totalCapLogged
members.desc: Whether the total connection cap has been logged.

members.name: _openTotal
members.desc: Open connections across all addresses.

members.name: _fails
members.desc: Failure counts by address.

members.name: _passwordFails
members.desc: Wrong password counts by address.

members.name: TryOpen
members.desc: Takes a connection slot for the address. False when it or the server is at its cap.

members.name: Close
members.desc: Records that one of the address's connections closed.

members.name: HeldOff
members.desc: True while the address has 8 recent failures.

members.name: PasswordHeldOff
members.desc: True while the address has 5 recent wrong passwords.

members.name: Fail
members.desc: Counts a failure against the address, logging when it reaches the limit.

members.name: PasswordFail
members.desc: Counts a wrong password, which is also a failure.

members.name: Count

members.name: Add
